content:
I visualized the CPU instructions and wallclock time in Mathlib, as a flame graph. The interface is simple: you can recursively descend down into folders and files, and down to individual lines of code.

number of CPU instructions (from radar): https://vilin97.github.io/lean-source-profiler/mathlib/
wallclock: https://vilin97.github.io/lean-source-profiler/mathlib-source/

Vasily Ilin said:

I visualized the CPU instructions and wallclock time in Mathlib

Cool project! Can you clarify where I can see the wallclock time? In the dropdown for "Width measures" I only see CPU Instructions and Source Line Count, but no wallclock time.

On the other hand, in your Lean Pool profile page I can see the compile time, but no info about CPU cycles or line count.

@Jack McCarthy
https://vilin97.github.io/lean-source-profiler/mathlib-source/ - this is the wallclock time (restricted to a single core of my particular processor which is an AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX processor).
Btw, Analysis is officially confirmed to be the biggest area of math, closely followed by Algebra and Category Theory :octopus:
